name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd - 544020 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Credit-led recovery at a microfinance-heavy SFB: Q4 PAT only INR 24 crore, GNPA 5.4% and credit cost 1.08% in the quarter, with management guiding to 2% steady-state credit cost by FY28.

triggers.label: Credit cost 6.7% FY25 → 4.7% FY26
triggers.quote: Credit cost came down from 6.7 % in FY 25 to 4.7% in FY 26.

triggers.label: Steady-state credit cost 2% from FY28
triggers.quote: So steady-state basis a 2% credit cost is an expected thing going forward.

triggers.label: Q4 PAT INR 24 cr vs INR 7 cr in Q3
triggers.quote: Profit after tax for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 24 crore, compared to INR 7 crore in Q3 FY26.
triggers.highlight: Profit after tax for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 24 crore

guidance.quote: So steady-state basis a 2% credit cost is an expected thing going forward.
We are planning to have an ROA of 2%
On a steady -state basis, 20 % to 25% is the growth which we are looking.
Cost-to-income ratio somewhere around 55%, plus or minus 2% is the guidance
somewhere around 7 %, plus or minus half percentage will be the NIM going forward.
We remain on track to achieve our stated target of 70% secured assets by March 2027.
we have given a gliding path up to 30%.

red_flags.label: Q4 credit cost 1.08% still elevated; provisioning backlog to continue in FY27
red_flags.quote: This year also there will be some backlog on provisioning, so from FY 28 you can expect.

red_flags.label: Microfinance book stable not growing; unsecured mix still ~40%
red_flags.quote: the microfinance portfolio remained stable in absolute terms, with its share reducing to 39% from 47% last year.

red_flags.label: Growth/ROA outlook evaded
red_flags.quote: It is a futuristic statement and I'm unable to give you at this moment.
